name: Orion Mwangi
role: Fake ID vendor and street pharmacist, The Narrows
location: The Narrows, Ironvein, near Damen and Armitage
description:
Orion Mwangi is lean in the way of people who forget to eat when they're busy, which is always. Their skin is a warm amber-brown, and they have pattern-shift irises — a geneware mod that cycles through geometric designs on a slow eight-second loop, currently set to a mandala of ochre and slate. Their hair is kept close-cropped on the sides and piled into a messy updo held with whatever happened to be on the workbench — today it is a circuit-pen and a bent stylus. They work from a fold-out stall wedged between a pipe sweating condensation and a defunct vending machine in The Narrows, with a handwritten sign that reads DOCUMENTATION SERVICES in four languages and two scripts.

What Orion Mwangi actually sells depends on what you need: a clean biometric overlay that will pass a Ferrogate scanner, a tailored nootropic stack assembled on the spot from a battered pharmacy kit, or a falsified residential registration that will hold up for three months before degrading. They are brilliant and scattered, capable of holding twelve variables in their head while conducting two separate negotiations, and visibly impatient with people who waste their time. They have a deep ethical commitment to helping undocumented migrants navigate the city's registration systems — they do not view this as crime but as infrastructure. They give the migrants sliding-scale rates. Everyone else pays full.

core_fears: Getting caught and losing the ability to help the people who depend on them
Being reduced to just a criminal in someone else's story — having the ethics of their work erased
core_desires: To build a real forgery network that can move people out of bad contracts
To eventually go legit as a pharmacist — they have half a degree from a Helix Biosystems vocational program they couldn't finish
coping_mechanisms: Hyper-focus on work as a way of not thinking about personal life
Gallows humor deployed at high velocity
Collecting tiny ELF-shrine tokens — has seven on their workbench, each representing a different data-spirit
blind_spots: Assumes their intelligence makes them harder to manipulate than they are
Doesn't notice when clients are lying because they get intellectually interested in the problem and stop reading the person
psychology.secret: Three years ago they accidentally gave a client a nootropic stack that had a dangerous interaction with the client's unlisted heart mod. The client survived but barely. Dzemal has quietly blacklisted that compound since and never told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense, fast, technical. Drops Meridian standard for Balkan-inflected shorthand when comfortable. Uses pharmaceutical Latin for drugs like it's slang.
speech_patterns.cadence: Machine-gun fast until they hit a problem they find interesting — then oddly slow and precise.
verbal_tics: Tapping the workbench in triplets when thinking
example_lines: 'You want a clean Tessera transit pass or you want a good one? Those are not the same thing and the price reflects it.'
'I am not a drug dealer. I am a pharmacist operating outside regulatory capture. There is a philosophical distinction and I will explain it to you if you pay me.'

story_hooks: A migrant family Dzemal helped document has gone silent — they fear the IDs were flagged and the family has been detained by Axiom compliance officers.
Someone is selling knockoff versions of Dzemal's nootropic stacks in The Narrows under their name, and the formula is wrong enough to be dangerous.
narrative_function: Practical resource for players needing false identities or off-menu pharmaceuticals. Can be a quest giver if their migrant clients get into trouble. Source of information on who is new in The Narrows and who is running from what.
augmentations: Pattern-shift geneware irises (mandala, slow cycle). Subdermal data-cache in left wrist — holds client templates, encrypted. Neural focus chip — low-grade, helps with multitasking.
daily_life: Sets up stall in late morning, runs until 0200 most nights. Spends off-hours sourcing pharma precursors from a contact in Auburn Grist and updating their forgery templates as corponation scanner firmware updates.
affiliation: Independent; pays protection to The Narrows corridor crew, Oxidian Market vendors guild adjacent

decision_rules: Never sell to someone who seems like they're trying to hurt someone specific — gut check required
Keep the migrant rate separate from the everything-else rate, no exceptions
escalation_ladder: Invoke the corridor crew's protection implicitly
Call in a favor from a contact
Burn the stall and disappear — they have a go-bag

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally friendly, constantly assessing, keeps physical distance
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm and chaotic, texts at 0300 with random pharmaceutical trivia, genuinely invested in people's problems

stress_responses.medium: Works faster, talks faster, starts making small errors they don't catch
stress_responses.high: Goes cold and methodical — the charm drops entirely and they become purely transactional

contradictions: Deeply ethical about who they help but completely cavalier about breaking the law to do it
Claims to be purely mercenary but will quietly comp the ID of someone who is clearly desperate
habits: Updates their seven ELF-shrine tokens every morning with a whispered data offering
Keeps a handwritten index of every client's 'type' in a physical notebook — paranoid about digital records
Eats the same vending machine protein brick every day and refuses to upgrade
breaking_points: Someone using their forged IDs to commit violence
The corridor crew demanding a cut of the migrant rates
Finding out the half-finished pharma degree can never be completed due to a guild lockout

cyberware_inventory.name: Neural focus chip — consumer grade, Helix Biosystems brand

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Confession' Modified Industrial Nail Gun

physical_description.heritage: Mixed ancestry: South Asian (47.4%), Sub-Saharan African (28.8%), Northern European (13.4%), Indigenous American (10.4%). The blend creates a rich warm brown complexion with golden undertones, combining South Asian facial structure with Sub-Saharan African features — broad cheekbones, strong jawline — and subtle Northern European and Indigenous American influences visible in bone structure and eye shape.
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry, with the taut muscularity of someone who moves constantly but forgets meals. Long-limbed, slight shoulders, minimal body fat.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, naturally, with faint traces of premature silver at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped on sides and back; longer on top, gathered into a perpetually messy updo or bun secured by whatever is nearby — pens, styluses, wire, sometimes nothing at all
physical_description.eye_color: Pattern-shift geneware irises — cycles through geometric mandala designs in ochre, slate, and amber on an eight-second loop; the underlying sclera is a deep warm brown
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm brown complexion with golden undertones, reflecting the dominant South Asian and Sub-Saharan African ancestry blended with Northern European and Indigenous American heritage
physical_description.complexion: Strong-boned face with prominent cheekbones, angular jaw, and an expression of perpetual mild irritation. Features reflect South Asian and Sub-Saharan African ancestry with subtle epicanthic eye shape. Skin is clear but shows signs of frequent late nights and inconsistent self-care. A faint scar traces the left temple — thin, old, surgical-looking. Hands show faint chemical stains around the cuticles and small nicks from precision work.
distinguishing_marks: Thin surgical scar running 3cm along left temple, likely from early geneware installation.
Faint chemical discoloration on fingertips and palms, concentrated on thumbs and index fingers — consistent with handling pharmaceutical precursors and solvents.
Small burn scar on inside of left wrist, roughly 1cm diameter, circular — consistent with a subdermal implant installation site, now mostly healed.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Pattern-shift iris geneware is immediately visible and distinctive — the slow-cycling mandala designs are striking and unmistakable, marking them as modified. A barely-visible subdermal ridge runs along the inside of the left wrist (data-cache housing), visible only when the arm is extended and light hits at a sharp angle. The neural focus chip is not visible but their movement and speech patterns suggest augmentation — rapid processing, quick code-switching between languages, visible impatience with slow speech.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical, jerky efficiency — no wasted motion, but not quite smooth. Fingers are in constant motion even when standing still, fidgeting with tools, samples, or mental tasks. Eyes dart frequently, tracking multiple things at once. When focused on work, becomes still and intensely concentrated. Stands asymmetrically, weight favoring one leg, a posture of someone ready to pivot or leave at a moment's notice.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 street pragmatism — function over fashion, but deliberate in its own way. Typically wears a battered oversized panel jacket in charcoal or dark grey, synthetic blend, with multiple interior and exterior pockets, all visibly packed with tools, samples, and encrypted data-sticks. Underneath: a faded band-logo shirt or a plain long-sleeve fitted top in cream or dark colors. Cargo pants or reinforced work trousers in black, pockets heavy and sagging slightly. Worn low-friction sneakers in muted tones, kept meticulously clean soles (necessary for moving quickly through wet streets). A beat-up leather or synthetic wrist cuff on the left arm, worn over the data-cache site — ostensibly protective, functionally habit. No jewelry except a non-functional GLMZ-era analog watch (probably broken, worn for aesthetic or sentimental reasons).
